important_limitations: All fitted constants are platform-specific and descriptive. Fit-only and AICc full-criterion are separate experiments. No SVD-proxy comparison is independent forward-error proof. The AICc benchmark includes common S->lambda mapper setup. Predictions for n beyond training/observed lengths are unvalidated. Numerical reliability must gate a production switch. Other criteria and mapping options need their own calibration.

models.theoretical_features: n^3 setup + R n^2 projection + MR n^2 full fits

validation.caveat: A holdout consisting of only one winning class does NOT establish accurate prediction of a switching boundary, even if every label is predicted correctly.
